title: Latent Telepathy: Multi-Robot Communication with Self-Supervised Perceptual Latents
abstract: arXiv:2609.23269v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In a decentralized multi-robot team under partial observability, the fact that decides a robot's next action is often visible only to a teammate. Existing decentralized methods communicate kinematic information, such as position or planned trajectory, which cannot convey what the teammate perceives. Learned communication in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) can carry perceptual content, but the resulting messages are task-coupled and opaque. We propose Latent Telepathy. Each robot broadcasts the perceptual latent vector it already computes for its own use, the output of an encoder trained with a self-supervised joint-embedding predictive objective, frozen, and shared across the team. A teammate learns to act on it from task reward alone. Because the encoder already runs for perception, the message costs no additional computation and a single compact vector of bandwidth. Because the encoder is frozen before any policy is trained

translated_title: 潜在心灵感应：基于自监督感知潜向量的多机器人通信
translated_abstract: 在部分可观测环境下的去中心化多机器人团队中，决定机器人下一步行动的关键信息往往只有其队友才能观测到。现有的去中心化方法传递的是运动学信息，例如位置或规划轨迹，这些信息无法传达队友所感知到的内容。多智能体强化学习（MARL）中的学习型通信虽然可以携带感知内容，但由此产生的消息与任务耦合且不透明。我们提出潜在心灵感应方法：每个机器人广播其已经为自身使用而计算的感知潜向量——即由自监督联合嵌入预测目标训练的编码器的输出，该编码器被冻结并在整个团队中共享。队友仅通过任务奖励即可学习如何基于该信息采取行动。由于编码器本来就在为感知而运行，这种消息不产生额外的计算成本，且带宽仅为单个紧凑向量。由于编码器在任何策略训练之前就被冻结……
tldr: 提出“潜在心灵感应”方法，让每个机器人直接广播其自监督编码器产生的感知潜向量作为通信内容，无需额外计算且仅占用单个紧凑向量的带宽，使队友能够仅凭任务奖励学会利用这些感知信息，解决了去中心化多机器人系统中感知内容无法传递的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes "Latent Telepathy," where each robot broadcasts the perceptual latent vector from its frozen self-supervised encoder as a communication message at zero additional computation cost and only a single compact vector of bandwidth, enabling teammates to learn to act on this perceptual information from task reward alone.
